question: Who among the following were the co-flag bearers for India in the closing ceremony of Paris Olympics 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manu Bhaker and PR Sreejesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manu Bhaker and PR Sreejesh **were the co-flag bearers for India at the closing ceremony of the 2024 Paris Olympics. 
 
• **Manu Bhaker**
 
 
• A **shooter who won two bronze medals at the 2024 Paris Olympic**s.
 
• She was the first Indian woman to win a medal in shooting at the Olympics. 
 
 
 
• **PR Sreejesh**
 
 
• A **goalkeeper for the Indian men's hockey team **who won a bronze medal at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
 
• He is also a hockey legend. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The host city of the 2024 Summer Olympics is Paris, France.
 
• The Motto is Made for Sharing.
 
• Skateboarding, sport climbing, surfing, and breaking have been confirmed as the additional sports proposed for inclusion at the Paris Olympic Games in 2024.
 
• Los Angeles, California, United States will host the 2028 Summer Olympics.
 
• The Tokyo Summer Olympic Games will be held from July 23 to August 8, 2021.
 
 
• They were originally set to take place from July 24 to August 9, 2020, but were postponed because of the COVID-19 pandemic
